contradicting_evidence: Current negative breadth and weak large/mid-alt participation could persist into a deeper downside retest.
BTC ETF inflows, growing stablecoin supply and strong 30d relative alt performance could support recovery if demand becomes sustained and broadly deployed.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A week-long recovery and a continued downside retest remain unresolved alternatives. Current weakness cannot be extrapolated confidently across seven days, and the available liquidity and rotation context cannot establish renewed broad participation. A durable directional edge requires subsequent flow and market-participation evidence.
falsification_conditions: Sustained spot-led gains, improving ETH/BTC, resilient broad participation across repeated observations and supportive settled flows would establish an upside case.
Persistent price weakness, deteriorating participation and ETH-relative performance, together with repeated adverse flow observations, would establish a downside case.
missing_evidence: A multi-session sequence demonstrating whether current weakness persists or reverses.
Subsequent settled BTC and ETH ETF flows and confirmation of stablecoin deployment.
Repeated dominance, relative-strength and breadth observations, including evidence beyond the Top-100 proxy universe.
Usable catalyst information and updated macro changes relevant to the coming week.
supporting_evidence: Rotation evidence is horizon-dependent: BlockchainCenter scores are 71 over 30d, 47 over 90d and 37 over 365d; the separate CMC 90d score is 56. These do not establish a consistent broad-rotation regime.
Positive stablecoin supply changes are enabling liquidity evidence, not confirmed buying demand.
The current negative cross-section and single positive hourly candle provide insufficient persistence evidence for a seven-day forecast.
Small-alt proxy relative resilience occurs alongside negative absolute returns; it cannot establish recovery or fill the unavailable microcap lane.
